Who qualifies: Penultimate or final-year students completing a bachelor’s, master’s or PhD degree

Qube Research & Technologies (QRT) is a global quantitative and systematic investment manager operating across liquid asset classes and markets worldwide. Our approach to investing is scientific: we bring together data, research, technology and trading expertise to develop and run systematic strategies.

Research is central to how QRT invests. Over the years, we have built a global research and execution platform spanning geographies, asset classes and trading horizons, from high to low frequency. This gives our researchers access to large and diverse datasets, sophisticated research tools and the infrastructure needed to turn research ideas into live trading strategies.

Our internships are designed to give students meaningful experience of that process. You’ll join a systematic team, work on real research or trading problems and learn from experienced researchers and traders. The environment is rigorous and collaborative: ideas are tested against data, assumptions are challenged and good questions matter as much as quick answers.

Your future role at QRT

Throughout the recruitment process, we’ll consider your skills and interests alongside the problems our teams are working on, with the aim of finding the strongest fit.

As a Quantitative Research Intern, you could contribute in one of two complementary areas within one of QRT’s systematic teams, spanning high, mid and low frequencies:

Research

Your focus will be on developing predictive signals from large and varied datasets. You’ll explore the data for patterns and form hypotheses about what might be driving them. From there, research is iterative: you’ll design tests, question the results, adjust your approach and test again. Working with other researchers, you’ll learn to distinguish promising signals from noise. In doing so, you’ll experience the full research process, from an initial observation to something that can be used in live trading.

Trading

You’ll contribute to the live deployment of QRT’s research by working directly with our systematic trading platform. You’ll monitor how signals behave in production, track performance, improve execution efficiency and help identify and manage potential risks. Working closely with senior Researchers and Traders you’ll investigate how strategies behave in production and look for ways to make them more robust and scalable. You’ll use quantitative analysis and programming to understand what is happening in live systems and determine where improvements can be made.

Across both areas, how you approach a problem matter. We’re looking for interns who are curious, creative and collaborative. You should be comfortable exploring ideas, asking questions and learning as you go.

About us

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Schroders Capital

Schroders Capital is the private markets business of Schroders with $113.7bn of AUM. We work as a global network of specialised, entrepreneurial teams. Experience

Through our financial advisory business, Lazard advises clients around the world on strategic and financial matters including mergers and acquisitions, restructurings, capital structure and capital raising. Our client relationships are built on trust and discretion. As the world’s largest advisory-focused firm, we have exceptional depth of expertise across industry sectors and geographies. We value the rich diversity that comes from blending local perspective with our global network.

Over the past decade, Lazard has advised on more than 500 restructurings worldwide, with an aggregate value of over $2 trillion, including many of the largest and most complex. A Career with Point72’s Market Intelligence Team

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll support Canvas team members as they work with our investment professionals and Compliance team to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques to alternative data sets. You’ll work alongside a talented team with diverse skills, backgrounds, and perspectives.

Canvas is the supply chain research group within Market Intelligence. Canvas conducts compliant supply chain research by developing deep industry expertise, talking with private company executives, and synthesizing information for portfolio managers and analysts. Our team produces impactful research that will change the way you look at the world.

About the Fundamental Researcher Internship

When you join the Canvas team, you’re signing up for the learning experience of a lifetime. You will never look at anything the same way—from grocery stores to tires to semiconductors. Every day, Canvas team members speak with some of the most successful private company executives and learn about the businesses they’ve spent their lives building. The team synthesizes findings in comprehensive reports that are consumed by our investment professionals. Other Market Intelligence divisions conduct quantitative research to explain what is going on in an industry. As a Canvas Fundamental Researcher, our qualitative research helps explain why it is happening.

During the 10-week program based in our New York office, you will gain exposure to:

- How Canvas develops subject matter expertise across a range of industries

- Gathering insights from small, medium, and large private company executives into their businesses and the industries in which they operate, including real-time changes in supply/demand dynamics, emerging competitors, markets, and technologies

- Business leaders across industries, collaborating with Canvas colleagues, and how Canvas research supports more informed investment decision making

Summer Internship Program at Point72

- Work alongside your fellow interns and be mentored by experienced professionals

- Attend sessions with senior leaders discussing their expertise and career paths

- Get hands on access to the wealth of tools and resources that Point72 employees use every day

- Gain exposure to groups and functions with unique responsibilities and perspectives on our industry

- Develop technical, writing, and presentation skills

- Participate in networking opportunities across the firm, with groups such as Trading, Finance, Trade Support, Compliance, and Technology

What’s Required

- Bachelor’s degree expected between Fall 2027 and Spring 2028

- Build effective working relationships across the Capital Markets business and wider Operations teams.

Are you a student interested in pursuing a career in investing? If you are graduating between December 2028 and July 2029, we invite you to apply for our 8-week summer internship, taking place from June to August 2028.

Launch your investing career in the Point72 Academy, an investment analyst training program designed to prepare you for a potential career on our fundamental equities teams. Since 2015, the Academy has graduated more than 250 analysts onto our platform as of August 2026; some are portfolio managers today.

The Point72 Academy Summer Internship combines structured training with real investing experience, including hands-on research on our investment teams. You’ll build the core skills used by public-markets investors and experience firsthand what it’s like to work as an Analyst at Point72. The internship can be your starting point into the full-time Point72 Academy Associate Program.

During the internship, you will:

- Build a foundation in company research, financial analysis, and the skills needed to contribute as an investment analyst

- Receive training in accounting, modeling, presenting, and compliance.

- Work directly on an investment team, gaining exposure to researching companies and industries alongside our analysts and portfolio managers

- Learn how investment ideas are developed, debated, and refined in a live market environment

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. We’re a firm that thrives on ideas, and we’ve found that the Point72 Academy has provided us with diverse viewpoints and perspectives, and we are able to offer support in their growth and development as analysts and portfolio managers.

Who we’re looking for : We welcome students from all academic disciplines. Your field of study or major is not a determining factor; we're looking for intellectual curiosity, integrity, strong judgment, and an interest in understanding businesses and markets.

- Manage global trading platform readiness: pre-trading & post-trading

- Incident management: create and send reports following established process

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

The Role:
The Transaction Monitoring (TM) Analyst is an experienced role within the Life First Line of Defence Anti Financial Crime Risk Management team. The role is responsible for investigating transaction monitoring alerts and supporting the team’s wider financial crime risk management controls, including referrals, escalations and financial crime markers. Combining anti-money laundering and fraud investigation skills, the TM Analyst identifies, assesses and responds to financial crime risk to protect M&G customers and the firm.

Main Responsibilities:

- This role will identify, investigate and manage financial crime risk across the Life book of business by conducting the below activities:

- Investigate and dispose of transaction monitoring alerts end to end within agreed service levels, establishing who was involved, what happened, how and why, and whether the evidence gives rise to, or resolves, a financial crime concern.

- Understand why each alert has triggered, including the rule logic and the money laundering or fraud typology it is designed to detect, and report rule, data or alert discrepancies to the relevant teams.

- Identify and test money laundering and fraud hypotheses, such as account takeover, impersonation, mule activity, layering, scams and third-party misuse, weighing red flags against mitigating evidence.

- Review identity, address and bank ownership documentation for authenticity and signs of manipulation, and act as an independent 4-eye checker for colleagues on high-priority cases.

- Apply, amend and remove financial crime markers on customer records in line with financial crime standards.

- Review fraud prevention referrals from operational teams where identity or bank verification checks have not been passed, making risk-based decisions and requesting further information where required.

- Manage referrals and escalations received into the Risk Management mailbox, and escalate suspicion or unresolved material risk to the appropriate specialist teams and Second Line of Defence, taking care to avoid tipping off.

- Request or apply proportionate interim safeguards to protect customers and the firm, with consideration for customers who may be vulnerable.

- Record clear, evidence-based rationales that allow an independent reviewer to fully reconstruct every decision.

- Complete peer quality checks, act promptly on quality feedback, and identify rule, control or process weaknesses to support continuous improvement.

Job Title: Associate, Credit Analysis
Contract Type: Permanent, full-time
Location: London, St Pauls
Department: European Liquid Credit

What the Hiring Manager says….
‘This is an exciting opportunity to join an energetic team that focuses on investing in liquid high yield and loan markets. You'll be in charge of managing a portfolio of credits, providing recommendations to the investment committee, and striving to maximize investor returns in the secondary market. When you join us, you'll need to work closely with portfolio managers, traders, other analysts, and professionals from ICG around the world. Having an investor mindset is crucial.’

Summary of our opportunity
ICG’s Credit Fund Management (“CFM”) business is a sub-division of Intermediate Capital Group which invests across liquid capital markets. CFM was originally launched in 1999 and we were one of the first European CLO managers. The division now manages a range of both market-value liquid funds and CLOs, all accessing sub- investment grade debt in Europe, North America and Australia, with teams based in London, New York and Sydney. CFM’s AuM is US$19 Bn, about 15% of the total firm AuM of US$126 Bn (as at 31 March 2026). The European team consists of 17 investment professionals of which 12 are sector focused credit analysts.

Our investment style is to take a fundamental, bottom-up approach to credit analysis in order to identify opportunities and overlay relative value view in portfolio construction. jobs.title: Commodities Quant Analyst
jobs.description:
Firm Overview

Verition Fund Management LLC (“Verition”) is a multi-strategy, multi-manager hedge fund founded in 2008. Verition focuses on global investment strategies including Fixed Income & Macro, Event & Multi-Asset RV, Equity L/S & Capital Markets, and Quantitative Trading.

Role Overview

Verition is seeking a Quantitative Analyst to join a commodities-focused investment pod in Houston. This is a highly research-oriented role working directly alongside an experienced Portfolio Manager to develop differentiated investment signals using alternative data and quantitative research techniques. The successful candidate will combine a strong foundation in statistics, financial modeling, and Python with a genuine curiosity for uncovering new sources of alpha.

Rather than focusing on software engineering, this individual will spend their time researching markets, identifying unique datasets, testing hypotheses, and developing predictive signals that can be incorporated directly into the investment process.

A significant portion of the role will involve sourcing, analyzing, and modeling alternative datasets related to global commodity markets. This includes working with data such as crude oil vessel tracking (AIS), shipping and freight activity, pipeline flows, refinery operations, storage and inventory data, weather, satellite imagery, and other non-traditional datasets. The objective is to transform raw information into robust, statistically validated signals that provide a measurable investment edge.

Responsibilities

- Develop financial time series models and predictive forecasting techniques across energy and commodity markets.

- Research, evaluate, and incorporate alternative datasets into the investment process.

- Design, test, and validate alpha signals through rigorous statistical analysis and backtesting.

- Build research pipelines to clean, organize, and analyze large structured and unstructured datasets.

- Leverage AI and machine learning techniques to improve feature engineering, accelerate research, and identify differentiated investment opportunities.

- Collaborate with the Portfolio Manager to rapidly prototype new ideas and continuously refine investment models as market dynamics evolve.

Qualifications

- Strong proficiency in Python and the broader scientific computing ecosystem, including Pandas, NumPy, SciPy, and scikit-learn.

- Experience with financial time series analysis, statistical modeling, feature engineering, and hypothesis testing.

- Knowledge of backtesting frameworks, predictive modeling, and signal evaluation techniques.

- Experience applying machine learning techniques and modern AI tools, including large language models, to quantitative research workflows.

- Proficiency with SQL, cloud-based data platforms, and working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

- Interest in commodities, global markets, and alternative data research.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

- High level of intellectual curiosity, strong work ethic, and a keen attention to detail.

- Ability to work effectively in a team-oriented, fast-paced, and dynamic environment

jobs.description:
- Département : Sustainability

- Durée du Stage : 6 mois

- Lieu : Paris

- Date de début : Mars 2027

Le rôle
Au sein de l' équipe Sustainability d'Ardian, vous interviendrez en support des collaborateurs dédiés à nos activités Real Assets — Infrastructure et Real Estate — et travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'investissement et d'asset management concernées.

Ce stage vous permettra de participer directement aux projets de transformation d’Ardian et de développer vos compétences au sein d’une entreprise leader sur les enjeux ESG. Vous approfondirez votre compréhension des marchés privés et de leur rôle dans le développement d’une économie résiliente et d’une croissance durable.

Vous contribuerez principalement aux activités d’engagement avec les sociétés du portefeuille Infrastructure, coordonnées entre l’équipe Sustainability et l’équipe Asset Management, notamment :

- Revue de la documentation ESG des sociétés du portefeuille Infrastructure, évaluation des progrès et soutien aux initiatives d’engagement thématiques ;

- Préparation de fiches synthétiques pour appuyer les échanges avec les équipes de direction et d’investissement, résumant les avancées sur les initiatives clés, les tendances et les objectifs de durabilité ;

- Contribution à la création de questionnaires pour collecter des informations ESG auprès des sociétés du portefeuille et participation aux échanges avec ces sociétés ;

- Suivi de l’avancement de la campagne de collecte de données, analyse et revue des données afin d’identifier les principales tendances ESG et alimenter la stratégie d’engagement ESG d’Ardian ;

- Préparation de rapports synthétiques en coordination avec l’équipe Asset Management pour partager les principaux enseignements avec les sociétés du portefeuille.

Autres missions indicatives :

- Soutien au développement des stratégies climat et biodiversité sur l’ensemble du portefeuille

- Réponse aux questionnaires de due diligence et de reporting ESG, préparer les decks de réunions avec les clients et des supports marketing pour les activités Real Assets

- Contribution à la production de notes thématiques

Compétences requises

- Intérêt démontré pour la durabilité et la finance durable ; la connaissance des concepts et réglementations ESG est un atout.

- Expérience préalable en stage dans le domaine des infrastructures (fonds d’investissement, conseil, bureaux d’ingénierie…) et compréhension des principaux enjeux de ce secteur.

- Solides compétences analytiques et en gestion de données, maîtrise d’Excel et d’autres outils d’analyse de données.

- Compétences en gestion de projet, efficacité, respect des délais, excellentes aptitudes en communication et en relations interpersonnelles.

Le profil

- Étudiant(e) en Master en ingénierie ou en économie avec un profil quantitatif.

- Maîtrise de l’anglais écrit et oral (toutes les missions et réunions se dérouleront en anglais) ; l’espagnol est un plus.

Autres informations

- Gratification selon profil

- Enveloppe CSE

- Remboursement du titre de transport (66%) et tickets restaurant

- Convention de stage obligatoire – provenant impérativement d’un établissement d’enseignement supérieur

To enhance your recruitment prospects and prepare for potential interviews, please consult our Resource Center . There, you will gain access to a wide range of advice, preparatory materials, and testimonials.

About Fidelity International

Fidelity International offers world class investment solutions and retirement expertise. As a privately owned, independent company, investment is our only business. We are driven by the needs of our clients, not by shareholders. Our vision is to deliver innovative client solutions for a better future.

Our people are passionate, engaged, smart and curious, and we give them the independence and the confidence to make a difference. While we take pride in the excellence of our investment solutions and client service, we know we can always do better. Established in 2007, FIL Technology (Dalian) Limited was the Fidelity’s first wholly owned enterprise in China. The team drives strategic initiatives, provide support services enabling our investment team, and partners with our investment leaders to strengthen oversight, risk controls & regional regulatory engagement. Within the IM Solutions function the Sustainable Investing Solutions team is responsible for supporting global FIL’s proxy voting activities as well as core governance & reporting activates underpinning FIL’s sustainable investment approach.

Verition Fund Management LLC (“Verition”) is a multi-strategy, multi-manager hedge fund founded in 2008. Verition focuses on global investment strategies including Fixed Income & Macro, Event & Multi-Asset RV, Equity L/S & Capital Markets, and Quantitative Trading.

Department Overview

The Treasury team manages the firm's liquidity, financing, collateral, margin, and prime broker and dealer relationships. Working closely with Portfolio Managers, the team executes securities financing (stock loan, repo, and swaps), optimizes margin requirements across counterparties, and manages the firm's excess cash and unencumbered assets. You will also collaborate with our financing desks in New York, Dubai, and Hong Kong for a genuinely global view of the firm's funding strategy.

- Manage the firm's securities lending book. Provide borrow color to PMs, negotiate fees on hard-to-borrow names, and identify opportunities to lend long positions.

Qualifications

- 2+ years in securities lending, prime brokerage, treasury, or financing at a hedge fund or investment bank.

Point72’s Corporate Access team is responsible for ensuring investment teams have the highest quality corporate access offering and services in support of their efforts to generate superior, risk-adjusted returns. We collaborate closely with the firm’s investment and Compliance professionals, leverage innovative data and technology, and collaborate and foster effective partnerships with external providers.

About the Corporate Access Internship

If you are interested in pursuing a career in corporate access, this 10-week summer internship will provide you a valuable experience at a complex global firm. During your time with us, you will gain exposure to: 

- Interacting with discretionary investment professionals and other internal stakeholders to support and advance the firm’s corporate access program, staying informed of evolving corporate access needs

- Building the relationships with our Compliance-approved broker community

- Managing requests from investment teams to attend Compliance-approved industry conferences and non-deal roadshows

- Observing corporate access data and technology related projects, including the implementation of analytics and reporting to identify trends and opportunities

Summer Internship Program at Point72

In addition to the learning and development you’ll receive in your day-to-day role with your team, as a part of our summer internship program you will: 

- Work alongside your fellow interns and be mentored by experienced professionals

- Meet your peers through designated intern programming, volunteer opportunities, and social events

- Attend sessions with senior leaders discussing their expertise and career paths

- Get hands-on access to the wealth of tools and resources that Point72 employees use everyday

- Interact with groups and functions with unique responsibilities and perspectives on our industry

- Develop technical, writing, and presentation skills

- Participate in networking opportunities across the firm

What's required

- Expected degree from December 2027 to August 2028

- Demonstrated academic success as reflected in a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.2

- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines in a fast-paced environment

- Strong analytical, writing, verbal communication, and technical skills

- Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with all levels of the team

- Ability to conduct yourself with professionalism and integrity at all times

- Commitment to the highest ethical standards

About Point72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry’s brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people’s long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/.

Job Description
Duration:  2 years
Salary : £27,400
Location:  Edinburgh
Start : September 2027
Qualification  – Level 3 Compliance & Risk apprenticeship with Kaplan.

Be our safety net
At Lloyds Banking Group, protecting our 28 million customers isn’t just important. It’s essential. From everyday payments to big business deals, people count on us to keep their money and data safe.

That’s where you come in. As a Risk Apprentice, you’ll learn how to spot problems before they happen, help teams stay on the right side of complex regulations, and keep our bank (and our customers) protected. Think of it as being the safety net for Britain’s biggest digital bank.

Two years. Real risks. Real impact
This two-year apprenticeship combines classroom learning with hands-on experience. You’ll rotate through projects that show you just how wide-ranging risk management can be - from fraud prevention to regulatory compliance.

You’ll cover topics like:

- Understanding legal and regulatory frameworks (yes, the rules of the game)

- Presenting complex information clearly (because jargon doesn’t help anyone)

- Reporting and analysing risk situations

- How to build evidence-based reports leaders can act on
And you won’t just learn theory. You’ll apply it in real life, every day.

The work you could be doing

- Helping colleagues apply legal and regulatory frameworks

- Spotting and reducing potential risks before they grow

- Writing clear reports that help decision-makers take action

- Communicating risks in ways that everyone can understand

Your skills toolkit
You’ll master:

- Risk and compliance basics (the “must-haves” in financial services)

- Analytical thinking and evidence-based reporting

- Communication skills that make complex stuff simple

- How to keep customers, colleagues and the business safe

Support in your corner
We’ll back you all the way with:

- Blended learning: real projects + tutor-led study

- Time dedicated to your development

- A mentor, a manager and a buddy who’ll share their experience

- A network of colleagues who’ve got your back (and your career)

Your future. Fully funded
We’ll pay your salary and cover the cost of your studies, giving you the opportunity to complete a fully funded level 3 apprenticeship in Compliance & Risk. Alongside this, you’ll build transferable skills that can open doors across the financial services sector, and gain valuable experience at the heart of a bank that supports millions of businesses and customers.

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .

Summary
Dust is hiring a User Researcher to be the connective tissue between our users and the teams building for them. This is a high-leverage, embedded research role — your work will directly shape product decisions, inform GTM positioning, and surface the insights that help us serve customers like Datadog, 1Password, and Cursor at a higher level. - Design and execute qualitative and quantitative studies — interviews, usability tests, concept tests, and surveys

- Identify the highest-leverage research questions and prioritise ruthlessly against the roadmap

- Deliver findings in formats that drive action, not just documentation

Partner with Product and Design

- Embed into product and design workflows so research informs decisions before they're made, not after

- Participate in roadmap discussions as a consistent, evidence-based voice for the user

- Challenge assumptions with data when it matters — and when it's uncomfortable

Support GTM and customer understanding

- Partner with Sales and Customer Success to surface patterns across customer conversations

- Help position Dust's value more precisely by understanding how users actually describe their problems and outcomes

- Contribute to ICP definition and segmentation work grounded in primary research

Scale your impact with AI

- Integrate AI-assisted research tools into your practice to move faster and cover more ground

A Career with Point72's Operations Team

Point72’s Operations team supports all operational aspects of trade processing, reconciliation, financing, and reporting firmwide for all products, including equities, derivatives, bonds, foreign exchange and futures, and digital assets across global markets.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Lead end-to-end trade lifecycle management across global markets for a wide range of products including equities, options, FX, CFDs, swaps, fixed income, repos, and futures, ensuring timely and accurate trade capture, confirmation, and settlement.

- Reconcile daily positions and cash across multiple counterparties, prime brokers, and custodians; investigate and resolve trade breaks and settlement exceptions to minimize settlement and operational risk.

- Partner with traders, portfolio managers, clearing brokers, and internal teams to resolve trade lifecycle issues, acting as a trusted operational liaison

- Manage the end-to-end processing of mandatory and voluntary corporate actions, determining position impact and executing necessary elections or adjustments.

- Execute and monitor FX transactions to manage foreign currency exposure that affects PnL and settlement flows.

- Maintain and update security master and reference data during Asian and European trading hours to support seamless post-trade processing across global trading activities.

- Produce and distribute daily exception reports, reconciliations, and operational metrics to senior internal stakeholders and external counterparties, highlighting trends and resolution status.

- Drive cross-functional projects to enhance settlement efficiency, confirmation workflows, and operational risk monitoring.

- Create and maintain process documentation, and contribute to continuous learning and improvement within the team.

- Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.

jobs.description:
Business operations at GSA encompass essential functions that drive operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and regulatory adherence. They include the management of trade execution, risk assessment, financial record-keeping, strategic budgeting, talent optimisation, and compliance with legal standards. This collective framework supports the firm's strategic goals and ensures a robust, compliant, and high-performing trading environment.

Regardless of your level of experience, if you’re talented in the areas of Compliance/Legal, Finance, HR, Office Management, Operations, Procurement, Recruitment or Trading Operations and wish to explore possibilities at GSA then we’re always open to making connections.

Unsure of where you might fit in? No problem. Send us your credentials regardless and it will be evaluated by one of the recruitment team here so we can check for you.

The Person

Our people are diverse, though we strive toward a few common traits:

- Conscientiousness: Your job really matters to us. We dig into issues and diagnose their cause, working effectively with colleagues to find immediate fixes and whenever possible, follow up with up with strategic solutions. You understand the value and importance of your role and are diligent in undertaking your responsibilities.

- Proactive and motivated. You thrive best when allowed to take initiative and possess a self-starter approach. You take pride in your work and look to perform to the best of your abilities.

- Interpersonal, collaborative and an effective communicator. Working at GSA requires effective collaboration with a range of colleagues, stakeholders and counterparties.

- Logical, numerate and possess a strong financial intuition: You seek to build upon strong critical thinking and analysis abilities with a deep understanding of your subject area and recognise the importance of context. You have a genuine interest in what we do and are naturally curious to build your understanding across multiple avenues of our business, how we operate and of the people working alongside you.

- Aptitude and adaptability. You strive to pick up and understand new concepts, systems, and strategies quickly.

- Highly organised and able to prioritise effectively. You enjoy crafting and working toward goals. You can efficiently collate, track, continually prioritise and proactively status report whilst managing the simultaneous resolution of many, often time-sensitive, issues.

Academic Requirements:

- We often find a good degree within an analytical field to be advantageous, but we are much more inclined to weight our evaluation toward your experience and career achievements when present.

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence— you will uncover insights about markets and the broader economy through deep compliant fundamental research and applying data science and engineering techniques to alternative data sets. In partnership with our investment professionals and Compliance team, our team of analysts, data scientists and engineers work together to produce compliant research and build tools that inform our firm’s investments. We look for other bright, motivated, and collaborative people to join our team and grow with us—a majority of the leaders in our group were promoted from within.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Macro Analyst, Market Intelligence covering the US, you will work with alternative data to gather macroeconomic context and identify insights relevant to rates and FX markets. You will then partner with our team of data scientists and engineers to develop analyses that you deliver as synthesized insights to our investment professionals to help aid in their research processes. - Analyze and interpret alternative data from multiple sources and develop subject-matter expertise on the key themes and KPIs that drive the markets within your assigned coverage

- Produce research for internal consumption by our investment professionals across a variety of channels, including written reports, verbal communication, data feeds, and visualizations

- Interact directly with our investment professionals to learn the macro investment process from them and help drive more informed investment decisions

- One to five years of prior macro/economics/investment research or consulting experience, including any relevant internship experience

- Proficiency with technical coding/programming and ability to participate in a live technical screen (SQL, Python)

- Experience with modelling and analyzing time series data as part of the macroeconomic or fundamental research process for business, public policy, finance, engineering, applied sciences, or other quantitative fields

- A passion for finance, research, and using data to solve problems

- Comfort with analyzing novel data and explaining concepts to non-technical partners

- Great organizational skills to handle a demanding workload, creativity, and a strong work ethic

- Ability to operate productively in a team environment

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Commitment to the highest ethical standards

WE TAKE CARE OF OUR PEOPLE

Duties: Design, develop, and refine fundamental supply-and-demand models for global crude oil markets, incorporating econometric techniques, statistical forecasting methods, and domain-specific variables such as production capacity, refinery utilization, inventory dynamics, trade flows, and geopolitical risk factors to generate actionable market outlooks for the trading desk. Architect and enhance proprietary quantitative analytics and data visualization tools using Python, SQL, and statistical libraries, enabling the desk to semi-systematically evaluate trade hypotheses, backtest market signals, and identify dislocations across derivatives oil complex. Conduct rigorous, time-sensitive quantitative analyses of short-term market dislocations, including supply disruptions, regulatory shifts, policy changes, and data releases, synthesizing structured and unstructured data sources to formulate probabilistic trade recommendations with defined risk-reward parameters. Develop and implement semi-systematic data validation frameworks to assess the integrity, completeness, and timeliness of proprietary and third-party commodity market datasets, applying statistical anomaly detection methods to identify and remediate data quality issues. Oversee and optimize automated data ingestion and transformation pipelines for fundamental market data, ensuring reliable integration of heterogeneous data sources into the desk's modeling and analytics infrastructure. Independently formulate and present proprietary trade ideas to senior traders and portfolio managers by synthesizing outputs from fundamental supply-demand models, applying advanced statistical reasoning and domain expertise in global oil markets to identify asymmetric risk-reward opportunities across the physical and derivatives crude oil complex.

Requirements: Must have a minimum of a Master’s degree or foreign equivalent in Financial Engineering and 1 year of experience as a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, Junior Fundamental Analyst, or related position for an investment/asset management organization.

Must have at least one (1) year of employment experience with each of the following required skills: Modeling using Python; Supply and Demand Modeling for Cushing, Canada, and USGC Crude; Curating, analyzing, transforming, storing, and documenting unique data sets for the purposes of supply and demand construction; and applying Quantitative standards to research and documenting results

Salary / Rate Minimum/yr: $150,000

Salary / Rate Maximum/yr: $165.000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available. 40 hrs/wk. Squarepoint is an EEO/AA employer.

At M&G, our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.

Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.

Through telling it like it is, owning it now and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for any of our roles and offer workplace adjustments to ensure you have the support you need to succeed in your role.

The Role: Campaign Planner

Great campaigns need more than a great idea. They need a plan that makes it happen.

The brief is agreed. The creative direction is taking shape. But turning it into a coordinated campaign, with every contributor, milestone and dependency moving in the right order?

That takes someone who can see the full delivery picture and keep every part connected. Someone who brings clarity to complexity. Who spots the gap before it becomes a problem. Who knows what needs to happen, who needs to be involved and what could knock the plan off course.
Sound like you?

At M&G, we’re looking for a Campaign Planner to help turn ambitious campaign ideas into coordinated, deliverable plans. You’ll provide the structure, pace and visibility that help teams do their best work, from the point the brief is agreed through to delivery, optimisation and learning.

See the whole plan. Keep every part moving.

Working closely with the Campaign Lead, you’ll translate an agreed brief and creative direction into a clear, sequenced campaign plan.

You’ll bring together inputs from insight, editorial, creative, digital, data, production and compliance, turning individual workstreams into one connected delivery schedule. You’ll map the milestones, resources, budget, handovers and dependencies that allow the campaign to move forward with confidence.

You’ll maintain a clear view of progress and plan health, keeping timelines, risks, issues, decisions and resource requirements current. When something is beginning to move off track, you’ll identify it early, work with the right people to resolve it and escalate where a wider decision is needed.

You’ll also manage the scheduling and trafficking of content and assets into production and distribution. Throughout delivery, you’ll maintain version control and a clear audit trail of changes, approvals and sign-offs.

Good with detail. Even better at making it useful.

This is not about maintaining a plan for the sake of it. The plan needs to help people make decisions, understand priorities and deliver better work.
You’ll coordinate working-level campaign check-ins, track progress and help unblock day-to-day delivery issues. You’ll make sure handovers between teams are clear and timely, closing the gaps that can leave activity disconnected or create unnecessary rework.

You’ll provide the Campaign Lead with an accurate, up-to-date view of delivery, enabling them to manage senior stakeholders and make informed decisions without having to chase the operational detail.
When you’re supporting more than one campaign, you’ll balance competing demands and resequence activity in line with the agreed priorities.

About Cubist

Cubist Systematic Strategies, an affiliate of Point72, deploys systematic, computer-driven trading strategies across multiple liquid asset classes, including equities, futures and foreign exchange. The core of our effort is rigorous research into a wide range of market anomalies, fueled by our unparalleled access to a wide range of publicly available data sources.

Role/Responsibilities:

We are seeking a quantitative researcher for the Cubist Machine Learning Research group with experience in machine learning, especially recent deep learning and natural language processing technology.

Researchers will use a rigorous scientific method to develop sophisticated trading models and shape our insights into how the markets will behave. Successful researchers manage all aspects of the research process including data ingestion and processing, data analysis, methodology selection, implementation and testing, prototyping, and performance evaluation.

Researchers will be introduced to industry standard datasets, including understanding which data may be relevant to a certain model or financial problem; how to collect, parse, and clean the data; how to incorporate the data into innovative functional models; how to construct and develop features from raw data; and how to estimate effectiveness of such features.

Researchers will also be provided with the opportunity to implement the full breadth of their knowledge and training to actively participate in all stages of research & development of financial models through use of machine learning. Based on experience from working with existing industry-standard models and algorithms, researchers will learn how to construct their own models in order to solve complex financial problems and enhance data prediction capabilities within the financial services industry.

Requirements:

- PhD or PhD candidate in machine learning, computer science, statistics, or a related field

- Experience with sequential modeling and time series forecasting using deep learning

- Experience with deep neural networks and representation learning

- Prior experience working in a data driven research environment

- Experience with translating mathematical models and algorithms into code

- Proficient in programming languages such as Python and R

- Experience with machine learning software libraries such as TensorFlow or PyTorch

- Experience with natural language processing technology a strong plus

- Excellent analytical skills, with strong attention to detail

- Interest in applying machine learning to finance

- Collaborative mindset with strong independent research ability

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

We’re looking for exceptional colleagues with unparalleled passion. If you’d like your resume to stand out, tell us about your exceptional personal achievements, even if they have nothing to do with finance. Of course we love to hear more about specific engineering or data projects that you’ve worked outside of school, or as part of your curriculum. If you’re proud of the work you did we want to hear about it. In addition to exceptional statisticians and engineers, we work with talented musicians, writers, mathematicians, and founders of non-profits; we’d love to learn more about what excites you.

The Investment Associate will support the Global Infrastructure & Real Assets Investment team by providing transaction support in deal execution (GP-led secondaries, LP portfolio secondaries, co-investments, and primary fund selection), asset management, and other ad-hoc projects and initiatives to promote growth of the team and wider business.

- Evaluate investment opportunities through financial modeling and due diligence

- Support client and fundraising requests and participate in client and fundraising meetings

- Conduct market and sector research for use in pitchbooks, client materials or external publications

Junior Depositary Officer
Stockholm
Heltid, tillsvidare
På plats/Hybrid

Just nu söker vi dig som är junior ekonom och som lockas av finansbranschen, mer specifikt fondmarknaden. Om du dessutom drivs av ägandeskap och självständighet i ditt arbete och om du är strukturerad, analytisk och har ett öga för detaljer, så är detta tjänsten för dig.

Om rollen
Som Junior Depositary Service Officer (Förvaringsinstitutstjänster) agerar du tillsammans med teamet förvaringsinstitut åt alternativa investeringsfonder vilket innebär att du ansvarar för delar av den lagstadgade granskning som krävs för att säkra en hög investerarskyddsstandard. Arbetet innebär mer specifikt att granska och analysera penningflöden, finansiella rapporter, NAV-beräkningar, investeringsbeslut och mycket annat och att verifiera att dessa överensstämmer med relevant fonddokumentation, avtal och lagstiftning.

Vilka blir dina ansvarsområden?

- Granska investerarrapporter och fonddokumentation i olika typer av alternativa investeringsfonder som investerar inom exempelvis fastigheter, private equity och olika skuldinstrument

- Granska beräkningar upprättade av fondförvaltare som exempelvis vid neddragning av kapital, räntebetalningar, utdelningar, NAV beräkningar och förvaltningsarvode

- Granska årsredovisningar, balans- och resultaträkningar

- Granska att fonderna följer sina interna riktlinjer för exempelvis värdering och att fondens intäkter används enligt bestämmelser i lag och fonddokumentation

- Kontrollera fonders penningflöden mot underliggande dokumentation

- Kontrollera fondernas äganderätt över tillgångar

- Löpande kontakt och nära samarbete med fondförvaltare

- Utveckla och effektivisera interna arbetsrutiner och processer

Vem är du?
Som person är du nyfiken, proaktiv och analytisk. Du arbetar självständigt när det behövs men värderar högt att vara en del av ett team som alltid hjälper varandra, du ser teamets framgång lika viktig som din egen. Du drivs av att hjälpa andra, vare sig det är dina kollegor eller dina klienter. Vidare beskriver du dig själv som ansvarstagande och känner dig trygg i att driva flera processer samtidigt. Du har även;

- Relevant akademisk examen inom ekonomi eller finans

- God systemvana, framförallt i Excel

- Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i såväl tal som skrift

- Erfarenhet av arbete med fonder och/eller kunskaper om fondmarknaden är meriterande men då detta är en junior roll är det inte en förutsättning

Vad erbjuder vi dig?
På Stockholmskontoret är vi idag 80 medarbetare som sitter i ljusa och fräscha lokaler centralt beläget i en av Hötorgsskraporna. Vi är ett gäng som älskar att hitta på saker tillsammans och vi värderar högt en arbetsplats som kan fungera i symbios med livet - vare sig det handlar om att riva av det där träningspasset på lunchen eller arbeta hemifrån. Vi erbjuder dessutom goda möjligheter till personlig och professionell utveckling samt konkurrenskraftiga anställningsvillkor och förmåner. Vad sägs exempelvis om ett friskvårdsbidrag på 5000 kr och SL kort varje månad? Rollen avser en tillsvidareanställning där du arbetar mot klient under konsultlika förhållanden – enligt oss det bästa av två världar.

För frågor gällande tjänsten eller rekryteringsprocessen är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Pontus Söderlind +46 (0)73 364 81 29, Head of Depositary Services Sweden. Intervjuer sker löpande så vänta inte med din ansökan, vi behöver den dock senast 3 december 2026.

Lazard Frères Banque est un établissement bancaire au service notamment de nos activités de gestion privée, regroupées sous l’entité juridique Lazard Frères Gestion. Cette dernière exerce une activité de gestion d’actifs pour le compte de tiers, clients institutionnels ou privés.
Lazard Frères Banque assure par ailleurs les fonctions de support pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe Lazard en France. Lazard Frères Banque abrite ainsi la Direction financière, la Direction des Ressources Humaines, la Direction fiscale, la Direction Audit interne, la Direction de la conformité, la Direction des risques, la Direction informatique et les services généraux.
La banque emploie 175 personnes.

Vos missions dans ce poste :
Vous êtes intégré à la fois aux équipes dédiées au développement et au déploiement des outils d'IA au sein de LFG, et à l'équipe Finance du groupe CFLF (dont les entités LFG et LFB) afin d'assister cette dernière dans la mise en œuvre d'outils d'IA propres à ses activités.

1. Formation
Concevoir et animer des sessions de sensibilisation à l'IA pour les collaborateurs. Accompagner la prise en main des outils déployés, en premier lieu Claude (Anthropic) : projets, skills et connecteurs.

2. Développement de projets IA
Identifier et cadrer les cas d'usage à fort impact : traitement et contrôle de factures, rapprochements comptables, production de reportings financiers, analyse budgétaire et autres, en fonction des besoins de l'équipe Finance. Développer des prototypes via Claude (Anthropic) ou en Python. Documenter les livrables pour assurer leur pérennité.

3. Création de skills et d'agents Claude
Concevoir et implémenter des skills Claude et des agents autonomes pour automatiser des flux récurrents : enregistrement des écritures comptables, codification des factures, formalisation des contrôles SOx, extraction de données clés (factures, relevés, reportings), analyse et contrôle des données, génération de synthèses financières et de tableaux de bord. Intégrer Claude aux outils de l'équipe via les connecteurs (Microsoft 365). Mobiliser en complément les autres outils du groupe (Rogo, Lazard GPT, Copilot) selon les besoins. Définir des KPIs pour mesurer l'impact.

4. Automatisation des tâches à faible valeur ajoutée
Cartographier les processus manuels et répétitifs (saisies, contrôles de cohérence, rapprochements). Déployer des solutions d'automatisation adaptées : skills et agents Claude, scripts Python, no-code/low-code. Mesurer les gains de temps et de qualité obtenus.

5. Veille technologique & réglementaire
Suivre l'actualité IA appliquée aux fonctions finance et au secteur de la gestion d'actifs (AI Act, LLM, GenAI).

Le profil que nous recherchons :
- Elève en école d’ingénieur, spécialisation IA/machine learning ;
- Connaissance de l’environnement réglementaire des banques et des sociétés de gestion ;
- Esprit d’analyse et de synthèse ;
- Sens de la rigueur et de l’organisation ;
- Appétence pour l’intelligence artificielle ;
- Bon relationnel et excellente communication à l’écrit comme à l’oral, en français et en anglais ;
- Esprit d’équipe et d’entraide/Autonomie et curiosité.

Les informations pratiques :
- Date de début : Septembre 2026 ;
- Lieu du stage : Paris ;
- Durée du stage : 3 mois.

Ce que nous offrons :
A travers ces missions, vous pourrez Intégrer une équipe juridique pluridisciplinaire traitant de questions complexes et internationales.

jobs.description:
Über AlixPartners

Expertise, Umsetzungsstärke, Verantwortung – AlixPartners steht für messbare Ergebnisse „when it really matters“. Als global agierende Unternehmensberatung helfen wir unseren Klienten dabei, schnell und entschlossen auf ihre wichtigsten Herausforderungen zu reagieren. Unsere erfahrenen Beraterinnen und Berater sind spezialisiert darauf, Unternehmenswerte zu schaffen, zu schützen und wiederherzustellen. Vom „manager magazin“ und der Wissenschaftlichen Gesellschaft für Management & Beratung (WGMB) wurde AlixPartners 2023 als umsetzungsstärkstes Beratungsunternehmen ausgezeichnet. Seit über 40 Jahren unterstützt AlixPartners seine Klienten – mit inzwischen rund 4.000 MitarbeiterInnen in 27 Büros weltweit.

Transaction Support

Zu unseren Klienten zählen Konzerne, Private-Equity-Investoren und Familienunternehmen, die wir bei ihren strategisch bedeutsamen Transaktionen begleiten.

Ziel ist es, den größtmöglichen Wert aus diesen Transaktionen zu schaffen – von der anfänglichen Idee bis zum Abschluss des Geschäfts.

Unsere Klienten begleiten wir sowohl auf der Käufer- als auch auf der Verkäuferseite – als M&A Lead Advisor oder in der praktischen Transaktionsunterstützung. Unser Leistungsspektrum umfasst den gesamten Deal-Lebenszyklus: von der strategischen Ideenentwicklung über Due Diligence und Vertragsverhandlung bis zur Post-Merger-Integration und zu Carve-out-Transaktionen.

Unser Angebot

Wirkungsvoll, hands-on und pragmatisch: Bei AlixPartners treibt Ihre Leidenschaft Ihre Karriere – durch hohe Leistung, Initiative und Resultate. Gemeinsam mit sehr erfahrenen Teammitgliedern werden Sie in kleinen Teams, Seite an Seite mit Eigentümer:innen, Vorstandsmitgliedern und Senior Management zusammenarbeiten. Sie liefern schnell umsetzbare Lösungen für dringende Fragestellungen, oft in (zeit-) kritischen Situationen, bei denen viel auf dem Spiel steht.

Durch unseren One-Firm Firm Ansatz bieten wir länderübergreifende Möglichkeiten für Weiterbildung sowie zur persönlichen und professionellen Entwicklung.

Außerdem erwartet Sie ein attraktives Gehaltspaket mit umfassenden Benefits und zahlreiche Initiativen unserer Employer Resource Groups – sprechen Sie uns gerne darauf an.

Ihr Profil

Unser Ziel ist eine nachhaltige Wertsteigerung für unsere Klient:innen. Dafür suchen wir die besten Mitarbeitenden im Markt.

- Zwischen 4 und ca. 15 Jahre einschlägige Berufs-/Beratungserfahrung im Corporate Finance und/oder M&A (Lead Advisor), bei der Transaktionsberatung (Sell- and Buy-Side), Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wachstums- und Portfoliostrategien, sowie bei Fragestellungen zum Thema Due Diligence (Buy- and Sell-Side) sowie Unternehmensbewertung

- Idealerweise zusätzliche Erfahrung in großen, das gesamte Unternehmen betreffenden Transformationsprogrammen, PMI, Carve-outs und/oder Restrukturierungsprojekten

- Hohe finanzwirtschaftliche und analytische Fähigkeiten sowie Modellierungskompetenzen – insbesondere in den Bereichen Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung, Bilanzanalyse und Cashflow-Modellierung – in Verbindung mit einem vertieften Verständnis von Finanzberichten

jobs.title: Post-Training Research Scientist - Forecasting and Reasoning
jobs.seniority_warning: Seniority not stated in the title
jobs.description:
POST-TRAINING RESEARCH SCIENTIST - FORECASTING AND REASONING

We develop and use LLMs for forecasting and decision-making in financial markets. Our research combines structured time series, unstructured information, and computational tools to study how models acquire useful evidence, make calibrated predictions, and revise their beliefs as new information arrives. We rely on proprietary datasets, domain expertise, and real investment applications to evaluate these capabilities. We deal with rich, challenging, noisy, non-stationary data. Our work focuses on advances in training environments, reward design, policy optimization, post-training and evaluation.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We are looking for an exceptional post-training research scientist to develop methodologies across environment and state construction, data generation and mixing, training, and evaluation. Working closely with other researchers, you will help shape the research agenda and translate successful methods into production. Specifically, you will:

- Develop post-training methods for forecasting and reasoning. Design and execute supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, on-policy distillation, and related methods to improve accuracy and calibration.

- Build environments and task distributions. Construct point-in-time environments combining historical observations, documents, prior predictions, and tools. Define tasks that require information gathering, belief updating, and forecasting across multiple horizons.

- Develop reward modeling and credit assignment methods, combining verifiable intermediate outcomes, expert supervision, preference data, and delayed feedback.

- Build efficient, reliable training systems. Collaborate with engineers to develop synchronous and asynchronous learning pipelines on multi-node GPU clusters.

- Establish rigorous evaluations that measure forecasting accuracy, uncertainty calibration, reasoning quality, robustness, and downstream utility. Design temporal holdouts and controlled ablations that distinguish generalization from leakage, distribution shifts, and evaluator noise.

- Productionize research. Collaborate with quantitative researchers to identify valuable model capabilities and deploy successful methods into reliable production systems.

WHAT'S REQUIRED

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in a quantitative or technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience developing advanced learning systems.

- Demonstrated expertise in large language model (LLM) post-training, reinforcement learning, environment design, or preference learning. Experience working in non-fully verifiable domains is preferred.

- Hands-on experience with distributed GPU training, including performance optimization, numerical stability, checkpointing, and reproducibility.

- Strong implementation skills in Python and PyTorch or JAX for research and production model training.

- Experience using distributed training and inference frameworks, including FSDP, DeepSpeed, SGLang, Megatron, verl, or Slime.

- Ability to design rigorous evaluations for forecasting accuracy, calibration, reasoning quality, robustness, temporal holdouts, and leakage detection.

- Experience with probabilistic forecasting, time-series modeling, asynchronous reinforcement learning (RL), tool-using agents, or production post-training systems from academic research, frontier AI labs, or teams developing advanced learning systems.

- Commitment to the highest ethical standards.

jobs.description:
A Career with Point72's Compliance Team

The Point72 Compliance department is an industry-leading team of compliance professionals who support global investment and trading activities by establishing and enforcing the firm’s compliance policies, providing real-time advice, and conducting pre- and post-trade surveillance. Our team is essential to Point72’s success and we provide mentorship, a growth path, and the opportunity for a long-term career with us.

What you'll do

- Monitor compliance restriction alerts and partner with the broader Compliance team to investigate, escalate, and resolve potential issues

- Investigate trading exceptions, prepare concise findings, develop recommendations, and escalate to senior members of Compliance

- Manage compliance-related security master data by maintaining accurate mappings, validating underlying information, and resolving issues adversely affecting trading compliance reports

- Partner with, among other functions, Technology to implement automated controls, reports, and dashboards that improve visibility and reduce manual intervention

- Track open technology issues and compliance projects to support timely resolution

- Analyze compliance reports to identify data issues and improve related processes

- Support artificial intelligence integration to enhance compliance monitoring tools

- Assist with real-time compliance coverage for trade approvals and time-sensitive trading matters

What's required

- One to three years of compliance experience within an investment manager, hedge fund, or broker-dealer

- Basic understanding of multiple asset classes

- Experience analyzing data and producing clear written summaries, escalation materials, and remediation plans

- Project management experience with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously

- Experience partnering successfully with cross-functional colleagues

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical compliance topics clearly

- Commitment to the highest ethical standards

We take care of our people

We invest in our people, their careers, their health, and their well-being. When you work here, we provide:

- Fully-paid health care benefits

- Generous parental and family leave policies

- Volunteer opportunities

- Support for employee-led affinity groups representing women, people of color and the LGBT+ community

- Mental and physical wellness programs

- Tuition assistance

- A 401(k) savings program with an employer match and more

About Point72

Point72 is a leading global alternative investment firm led by Steven A. Cohen. Building on more than 30 years of investing experience, Point72 seeks to deliver superior returns for its investors through fundamental and systematic investing strategies across asset classes and geographies. We aim to attract and retain the industry's brightest talent by cultivating an investor-led culture and committing to our people's long-term growth. For more information, visit https://point72.com/ .

The annual base salary range for this role is $120,000-$150,000 (USD) , which does not include discretionary bonus compensation or our comprehensive benefits package. Actual compensation offered to the successful candidate may vary from posted hiring range based upon geographic location, work experience, education, and/or skill level, among other things.

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our Investment Professionals and Compliance team to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research.
Canvas is the supply chain research group within Market Intelligence. Canvas conducts compliant supply chain research by developing deep industry expertise, talking with private company executives, and synthesizing information for portfolio managers and analysts – our team produces impactful research that will change the way you look at the world.
WHAT YOU’LL DO
When you join the Canvas team, you’re signing up for the learning experience of your life. You will never look at anything the same – from grocery stores to tires to semiconductors. Every day you will speak with some of the most successful private company executives and learn about the businesses they’ve spent their lives building. You will synthesize your findings in comprehensive reports that are consumed by our investment professionals.
Other Market Intelligence divisions do quantitative research to explain what is going on in an industry. As a fundamental researcher, your qualitative research will explain the why. In this role you will:
• Become a subject matter expert on an assigned industry

• Intellectual curiosity, creative thinking, maturity
• Highest standards of ethical decision making

On our proprietary research team—Market Intelligence—you’ll partner with our Investment Professionals and Compliance team to uncover insights about companies, industries, and the broader economy through deep fundamental research.

Stage HF – Contrôleur des Risques Bancaires – Janvier 2027
Lazard Frères Banque est un établissement bancaire au service notamment de nos activités de gestion privée, regroupées sous l’entité juridique Lazard Frères Gestion. Cette dernière exerce une activité de gestion d’actifs pour le compte de clients tiers, institutionnels ou privés.
Lazard Frères Banque assure par ailleurs les fonctions de support pour l’ensemble des entités du groupe Lazard en France. Lazard Frères Banque abrite ainsi la Direction financière, la Direction des Ressources Humaines, la Direction fiscale, la Direction Audit interne, la Direction de la conformité, la Direction des risques, la Direction informatique et les services généraux.
La banque emploie 175 personnes.

Vos missions dans ce poste :
• Refonte du processus de mise à jour de la cartographie des risques
• Suivi quotidien des limites (change, contreparties, grands risques)
• Suivi des intermédiaires (contreparties de trésorerie et dépositaires titres)
• Mise à jour annuelle du Rapport annuel sur le contrôle interne

Le profil que nous recherchons :
- Formation : Étudiant en Master 2 Droit ou Master 2 Conformité (droit bancaire et financier, droit des affaires, conformité, régulation financière) ou élève‑avocat en stage PPI.
- Compétences :
- Solides connaissances en droit bancaire, réglementation ACPR/AMF et mécanismes de contrôle interne.
- Capacité à analyser et synthétiser des textes réglementaires (veille, interprétation, impacts opérationnels).
- Intérêt pour la gestion des risques, la conformité et la rédaction de politiques internes.
- Aisance rédactionnelle en français ; rigueur, sens du détail et capacité à structurer des documents réglementaires.
- Une première expérience en cabinet spécialisé en services financiers, en institution financière ou en conformité est un atout
- Qualités personnelles : autonomie, curiosité, fiabilité, discrétion professionnelle, capacité à travailler en environnement exigeant.
- Langues : maîtrise du français et bonne compréhension de l’anglais juridique..

Les informations pratiques :
• Date de début : Janvier 2027 ;
• Lieu du stage : Paris ;
• Durée du stage : 6 mois.
Ce que nous offrons :
Nos stagiaires et apprentis sont potentiellement nos futurs talents. Le feedback des stagiaires et apprentis qui vous ont précédé nous permet de continuellement améliorer nos stages et alternances. Depuis 2023, Lazard Frères Gestion et Lazard Frères Banque ont systématiquement obtenu le label HappyTrainees. Travailler chez Lazard, c’est travailler pour une organisation qui se soucie de vos attentes, du développement de vos compétences et de votre environnement de travail.

La diversité et l’inclusion chez Lazard :
Chez Lazard, nous voulons promouvoir un environnement de travail inclusif, où chaque collaborateur est traité de façon juste, équitable et respectueuse dans toute sa diversité.
Engagés dans une démarche socialement responsable, nous croyons profondément que la diversité et l'inclusion sont clés pour permettre à nos entreprises de réaliser leur potentiel de croissance. Nous nous engageons à continuellement améliorer nos pratiques en matière de diversité et d'inclusion ainsi qu’à continuer à sensibiliser l’ensemble de nos collaborateurs sur ces thématiques essentielles.

Life at UiPath
The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

Could that be you?

Our mission
The Enterprise Sales Executive at UiPath will work with top Enterprise accounts across UAE & GCC countries.
Our sales team is built with experienced, entrepreneurial, and high-energy software sales executives. They work every day with C-level executives and business leaders, through to heads of process improvement and of course automation, to deliver business and individual value to client organizations.

What you'll do at UiPath

- Analyze the territory/market potential and develop sales strategies to maximize revenue potential.

- Achieve agreed upon sales targets and outcomes within quarterly schedule.

- Evangelize UiPath’s brand in the marketplace by presenting, promoting and selling our solutions by leveraging a value selling approach.

- Educate customers on how our solutions can benefit them financially and professionally.

- Establish, develop, and maintain positive business and customer relationships in the territory.

- Develop trusted relationships with local partners and global systems integrators to cultivate new opportunities and drive successful customer implementations

- Partner with the CSM group to ensure the customers receives maximum value and expedites customer issues as they arise.

- Monitor our industry competitors, new products, and market conditions to understand a customer's specific needs.

- Supply management with reports on customer needs, problems, interests, competitive activities, and potential for new products and services.

- Also, as an employee of UiPath you are required to comply at all times with UiPath’s policies that were communicated to you from time to time and that are available on Inside UiPath.

What you'll bring to the team

- Years of experience selling business solutions directly to top executives for large companies in UAE and any other GCC countries.

- Successful quota attainment year-over-year, growing an enterprise client portfolio through new business acquisition and account expansion.

- Ability to communicate new and complicated concepts in an easy-to-understand way that creates a high level of desire for the solution.

- Ability to grow an enterprise client portfolio.

- High aptitude for cross-functional collaboration and cross-functional influence internally and externally.

- Willingness to travel - 25%

- Fluency in English

jobs.description:
About Dust

Work is being rewritten, and the people holding the pen are the ones who actually run it.

With enterprise-grade governance, flexible model choice, and a collaborative interface for humans and agents to work together, Dust empowers AI Operators at the world’s fastest-moving companies to rewire how work gets done.

With 70%+ weekly active users, people stick with Dust as much as they do with Slack and Notion. We don't get piloted and shelved. We land once, and spread. We're at an exciting stage of our journey, and growing fast.

We're serving great customers like Datadog, 1Password, Cursor, Clay, Vanta and Persona, and aim to x5 our growth by the end of 2026.

Dust is backed by Sequoia with a determined team of optimists (coming from Stripe, OpenAI, and Stanford) who like to focus on users, ship fast, and don't take themselves too seriously while doing so. The Generalist named us among the Future 50 .
Summary

Every large group in Europe has bought an AI assistant, or is buying one this year. The next decision is harder: how their teams' own work runs on agents, across their own systems, governed, on top of what they already pay for. That is what Dust sells, and this role owns that decision inside a handful of France's largest groups.
You will be one of our first Strategic Account Executives. We are looking for people who have been at the top of every team they have joined, wherever they started.

The Role

- 5 to 8 named groups, 5,000+ employees, mostly headquartered in France. You own each relationship globally, across subsidiaries and countries.

- Some are already customers. They started with one team and grow as more teams build their own agents. Their renewals are where your account grows, and you run them.

- The others you open. We go in through the executive who owns the group's AI programme, before any tender is written. Our founders and executives work your accounts with you, and so do the consulting firms that run these programmes.

- Deals of €300K to €1M+ a year, decided by the executive committee, with IT, security, procurement and the business in the room.

- You run the deal team: solutions engineers, customer success, partners and founders, brought in when you decide.

- You write the playbook. How Dust sells to large groups is being built now, by the people in this seat.

What success looks like

- 90 days: an account plan for each group, the owner of the AI programme identified in all of them, and a first executive meeting held in at least half.

- 12 months: a first group-level deal signed, and one existing account growing across new teams.

Who we are looking for

- You have been at or near the top of every team you joined. Tell us your rank in each role, and where you started. We care more about how far you have come than about the logos on the way.

- You have opened large accounts yourself, without a big brand or an inherited list doing the work.

- You have led a deal decided at executive level, with procurement and legal involved, and you can walk us through every step of it.

- You have grown an account after the first deal, and you think in what an account is worth in three years.

- You use AI in your own work. If you have built an agent, show us.

- Fluent French and English. Based in Paris or moving here, with regular travel in France and Europe.

We do not screen on years of experience or on the size of your last employer. If you have been the best at what you did and want a bigger game, apply [...]

jobs.description:
(Junior) Depositary Services Officer
Location: Amsterdam or Maarsbergen
Contract Type: 12-month fixed-term contract with the prospect of a permanent contract
Working Model: Hybrid (3 days per week in the office)
Working Hours: Full-time (40 hours per week)

Why you could be a great fit
You enjoy working in a dynamic and regulated environment, take ownership of your responsibilities, and have a keen eye for detail. You are naturally curious, eager to learn, and motivated to contribute to a high-performing team focused on delivering exceptional service to clients.

Some of the things you’ll be doing

- Performing and reviewing core depositary activities, including cash flow monitoring, asset safekeeping, and oversight functions.

- Monitoring and reconciling fund cash accounts on a daily basis, identifying and escalating any unusual or inconsistent transactions.

- Conducting asset safekeeping controls by verifying, documenting, and maintaining records of assets held by the fund or by the fund manager on behalf of the fund.

- Carrying out oversight activities to ensure that fund operations and transactions comply with applicable regulations, fund documentation, and internal procedures.

- Preparing and reviewing depositary work in line with the four-eyes principle, ensuring accuracy, quality, and regulatory adherence.

- Collaborating closely with Senior Depositary Officers and Depositary Directors to build and maintain strong client relationships.

- Acting as a trusted partner to clients, providing high-quality service and support on depositary-related matters.

- Contributing as a key member of a collaborative team environment focused on delivering exceptional client service and operational excellence.

What technical skills, experience, and qualifications do you need?

- A Bachelor’s (HBO) or Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

- Fluency in English and Dutch is required.

- Initial professional experience within depositary services, investment funds, banking, financial services, or a similar regulated environment. Experience coordinating projects, mentoring colleagues, or leading small initiatives is considered an asset.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build effective relationships with colleagues, clients, and key stakeholders.

- A team-oriented mindset, combined with a high level of energy, motivation, adaptability, and a solution-driven approach.

- A commitment to fostering an open, collaborative, and integrity-driven culture where professionalism and mutual respect are at the core of everything you do.

- Excellent organizational skills, with the ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Knowledge of the AIFMD, UCITS framework, and the Dutch regulatory landscape is advantageous but not essential.

Inclusion at EQT
